notes.title: Update 2.0.1
notes.notes:
- Conducted a large-scale cleaning of objects that could cause FPS to drop. 

 - Completely redesigned light and lighting on all locations. 
 - Added auto saves. 
 - Fixed a bug with knives, they disappeared and players could not find them.
